blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — General Santos City lone district Rep. Shirlyn Bañas-Nograles on Friday called the proposed joint venture of South Cotabato II Electric Cooperative Inc. (Socoteco II) with Ignite Power and Energy Holdings Inc. a “corporate takeover”. Bañas-Nograles said, in a statement, that the proposed Conditional Joint Venture Agreement (CJVA) warrants “serious scrutiny”, primarily as Ignite gets 70 percent of the stake in the venture. This means, only 30 percent minority interest will be left for its original stakeholders, stripping the member-consumer-owners’ (MCOs) control over their cooperative, she argued.
